title: Mention references: refs.js now rebuilds its own icon, no hand-run script

chat.text: Decision: a computed-on-change index on the dev server's existing shared watcher (Server/plugins/MentionSync.js) — not the owner's own floated alternative, a per-folder meta.json snapshot, because a snapshot is a second index shape next to refs.js (one index, one shape, computed, never typed).
